description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Survey layout lines represent public rights-of-way for gas, stormwater, transmission, water and Tacoma easements. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including Cogo_Flg, Calc_Flg, CenterlineType, DirectionUnit, DistanceUnit, CenterlineComment. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. Rights-of-way describe legal/survey corridors, not the exact installed utility network or available capacity. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
